# Open Civic Web

> Free, nonpartisan, plain-language public records of local government in Florida: around Tampa Bay, the
> Temple Terrace City Council and the Hillsborough, Pasco and Hernando county commissions (which govern
> Brandon, Lutz, Wesley Chapel and Spring Hill); in southeast Volusia County, the Edgewater City Council and
> the Oak Hill City Commission. Collected nightly from official sources; every record links to its source.
> Headlines are produced by fixed rules, not AI, and the official wording is always shown.

Pages count recorded votes; they never say why anyone voted or whether a decision was good. Hillsborough votes
come from the Clerk's Master Voting Record (2014 on); Pasco and Temple Terrace votes are read from the Clerk's minutes;
Hernando and Edgewater votes come from their Legistar records. New Smyrna Beach isn't collected: its records site asks
automated tools not to.

## Start here

- [Home: pick an area](https://bgraham1214.github.io/open-civic/index.html)
- [Temple Terrace City Council records](https://bgraham1214.github.io/open-civic/templeterrace.html)
- [County commission records and search](https://bgraham1214.github.io/open-civic/counties.html)
- [Southeast Volusia city records and search](https://bgraham1214.github.io/open-civic/volusia.html): Edgewater, Oak Hill, New Smyrna Beach
- [Public money to companies](https://bgraham1214.github.io/open-civic/companies.html): companies and organizations the governments agreed to pay (contracts, purchases, change orders, grants), decision by decision, with approved amounts (not payments) and factual flags (no competitive bidding, money added to a contract, approved over a no vote, $1 million or more on consent, conflict-of-interest abstentions)
- [Spotlight](https://bgraham1214.github.io/open-civic/spotlight.html): decisions tagged by fixed rules as new restrictions (bans, moratoriums, fines) or as money, land or breaks for companies (tax breaks, incentives, land sales and leases, no-bid purchases of $100,000 or more)
- [Temple Terrace City Council meetings](https://bgraham1214.github.io/open-civic/meetings/templeterrace.html): one page per meeting, decisions grouped by topic with plain headlines, outcomes and who voted no
- [Temple Terrace City Council members](https://bgraham1214.github.io/open-civic/council/templeterrace.html): each member's recorded votes
- [Hillsborough County Commission meetings](https://bgraham1214.github.io/open-civic/meetings/hillsborough.html): one page per meeting, decisions grouped by topic with plain headlines, outcomes and who voted no
- [Hillsborough County Commission members](https://bgraham1214.github.io/open-civic/commissioners/hillsborough.html): each member's recorded votes
- [Pasco County Commission meetings](https://bgraham1214.github.io/open-civic/meetings/pasco.html): one page per meeting, decisions grouped by topic with plain headlines, outcomes and who voted no
- [Pasco County Commission members](https://bgraham1214.github.io/open-civic/commissioners/pasco.html): each member's recorded votes
- [Hernando County Commission meetings](https://bgraham1214.github.io/open-civic/meetings/hernando.html): one page per meeting, decisions grouped by topic with plain headlines, outcomes and who voted no
- [Hernando County Commission members](https://bgraham1214.github.io/open-civic/commissioners/hernando.html): each member's recorded votes
- [Edgewater City Council meetings](https://bgraham1214.github.io/open-civic/meetings/edgewater.html): one page per meeting, decisions grouped by topic with plain headlines, outcomes and who voted no
- [Edgewater City Council members](https://bgraham1214.github.io/open-civic/council/edgewater.html): each member's recorded votes
